QUOTE: This is the standard llama.cpp way to size a buffer before filling it. It is not retry: there is no loop, no backoff, and the second call runs unconditionally on the same input.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies a size-then-fill pair rather than retry and states no loop, no backoff, and a single unconditional second call; it never mentions "no delay" or "no attempt counter" explicitly, but "no loop" and "no backoff" cover the substance.
